critical_findings.finding: O2 parallel fan-out/fan-in can become non-reproducible if integration merge/apply ordering (or conflict resolution) depends on wall-clock lane completion timing, nondeterministic patch enumeration, or tool output ordering. This can yield different merged repo states across reruns, breaking auditability and undermining deterministic gates/trace.

closure.closure_target: Define and validate a canonical, timing-independent merge ordering + conflict-resolution protocol, and record it as first-class artifacts consumed by validators.

critical_findings.finding: Parallel lanes increase the chance of audit-spine integrity violations: non-monotonic or interleaved event_log sequencing, missing stage_handoffs for sub-lane transitions, or accidental mutation of supposedly immutable artifacts (run_manifest, canonical artifacts) due to concurrent writes or insufficient store-level immutability controls. This can invalidate evidence pointers and make replay/resume untrustworthy.

closure.closure_target: Make audit-spine ordering/immutability properties explicit and mechanically enforced under concurrency; ensure per-lane and global checkpoint semantics are unambiguous.

closure.required_mitigation: Specify: (1) event_log sequence allocation (single global sequencer or lane-scoped sequences + deterministic merge into global order), (2) immutability guarantees at the storage API (write-once + content-hash addressing), (3) stage_handoff cardinality rules for per-lane sub-stages (Generate/Validate/Review/Patch) and global stages, and (4) validator that checks monotonic ordering, presence of required handoffs, and immutability hashes before any stage transition.

critical_findings.finding: Forbidden/protected path controls can be bypassed by patchsets that exploit path normalization edge-cases (e.g., symlinks, .. traversal, case-folding), file operation types not covered by simple globs (rename/delete), or tooling side-effects during integration. In O2, integration fan-in amplifies blast radius: a single bypass can alter CI/release/auth/deploy config or other protected surfaces.

closure.closure_target: Harden patch_apply and validator enforcement to cover all file operations and path normalization semantics deterministically, including symlink and traversal defense.

closure.required_mitigation: Define patchset schema to enumerate explicit file operations (add/modify/delete/rename) with normalized absolute paths; patch_apply must reject any path that, after realpath resolution, escapes repo root or crosses symlink boundaries. Enforce protected-path policy both pre-apply (static diff inspection) and post-apply (repo_snapshot changed-files verification). Add explicit deny rules for symlink creation/modification unless allowlisted, and ensure glob matching occurs on normalized canonical paths.

critical_findings.finding: Secrets can still persist despite scanning if detection occurs after artifacts/logs are written, if patchsets include encoded/binary content that scanners miss, or if context packs/stage_handoffs copy sensitive substrings. O2 increases artifact surface area (per-lane + integration artifacts), raising leak probability and retention footprint.

closure.closure_target: Guarantee pre-persistence secret scanning/redaction and expand coverage to all artifact types produced in parallel lanes (including diffs, snapshots, context packs, stage handoffs, and release bundles).

This risks freezes with unverifiable trace or blocks progress late (high rework).

closure.closure_target: Finalize artifact_ref canonical format and enforce resolvability invariants; require resolvable evidence pointers as an early gate (not just at Freeze).

critical_findings.finding: RFC6902 patch safety is vulnerable to concurrency and semantic corruption: multiple lanes/integration may patch shared canonical JSON artifacts (work_plan, workspace_index, decision_record) causing lost updates; additionally, 'smallest passing repair' selection (fewest ops/bytes) can deterministically choose a logically wrong but test-passing patch (technical debt or silent spec divergence).

closure.closure_target: Make canonical JSON artifacts single-writer or define deterministic merge semantics; add semantic validators and selection safeguards beyond size-only heuristics for critical artifacts.

critical_findings.finding: Bounded per-lane context packs can omit cross-lane dependency signals, leading to locally passing lane outputs that systematically fail at integration; conversely, integration packs may exceed bounds and get truncated, causing reviewer/judge decisions to be made on incomplete evidence. Current acceptance tests do not explicitly validate lane-partition correctness or context pack adequacy for hidden dependencies.

closure.closure_target: Add deterministic context-pack adequacy gates and explicit acceptance tests for lane partitioning correctness and required cross-lane context inclusion.

critical_findings.finding: Multi-vendor writer/reviewer/judge separation can fail in practice due to limited model portfolio availability (assumption low confidence) or misconfigured routing, resulting in self-review/self-approval in lanes or integration. In O2, repeated parallel invocations increase configuration surface area for accidental role-collision.

closure.closure_target: Make role/vendor separation constraints machine-checkable and enforce them as a pre-dispatch gate for every stage invocation (including per-lane).
